summary.zh: 查看实验结果、进度与在跑的循环
summary.en: See experiment results, progress and running loops.

description.zh: 列出各实验的当前状态、历史结果和活跃的定时循环，支持按领域筛选，也可导出为 Markdown 或 CSV。适合定期查看进展，或确认某个实验是否还在跑时使用。
description.en: Shows each experiment's status, result history and any active scheduled loop, with filtering by domain and export to Markdown or CSV. Use it to check progress or confirm whether an experiment is still running.
